words.meaning: an early model built to test a design
words.example: The team tested a prototype before starting production.

sentencePractice.prompt: We built an early model to test the design before production. That model is a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A physical early test model is neither a requirements document nor an allowed measurement difference.

words.meaning: a detailed statement of what a design or product must do
words.example: The specification gives the required size and operating temperature.

words.meaning: the allowed difference between a specified measurement and the actual measurement
words.example: The hole must be made within a tolerance of one millimetre.

sentencePractice.prompt: The drawing allows the width to vary by 0.1 mm from the stated value. This allowed difference is the ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: An allowed dimensional difference is not a supported force or useful-output proportion.

words.meaning: one part of a larger machine or system
words.example: Each component has a number on the assembly drawing.

words.meaning: the process of putting separate parts together
words.example: Final assembly takes place at the factory.

words.meaning: work done to keep equipment in good working condition
words.example: Regular maintenance helps prevent unexpected breakdowns.

words.meaning: damage that develops in a material after repeated loading
words.example: Small cracks can grow because of fatigue.
words.usageNote: ここでは繰り返し荷重による材料の「疲労」。人の疲れという意味ではありません。

words.meaning: the gradual damage to a material caused by chemical reactions with its surroundings
words.example: This coating helps protect the metal from corrosion.

sentencePractice.prompt: Chemical reactions with moisture gradually damage the metal. This damage is ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: The explicit chemical cause excludes repeated-loading fatigue and back-and-forth motion.

words.meaning: the share of supplied energy or resources that becomes useful output
words.example: Better insulation improves the efficiency of the heating system.

words.meaning: the ratio of available strength to the load a design is expected to carry
words.example: The engineer selected a safety factor to allow for uncertainty.
